items.reason: The gap is already closed and already gated: no `${{ }}` reaches any `run:` in any of the 7 workflows (every untrusted value in agent-dispatch.yml and autofix.yml goes through `env:`), and scripts/security/check-actions.mjs enforces it with a blocking `run-injection` rule plus `script-injection` and `untrusted-checkout`, run as `npm run security:actions` in ci.yml on every push and PR.

Required checks are already declared in a reviewable file — .github/rulesets/main.json lists all 11 required contexts plus deletion/non_fast_forward, .github/rulesets/README.md explains the admin-bypass split, and `npm run review:gate` fails ci.yml when a required context no longer matches a job name (`--verify` asks GitHub whether it is actually applied).

Added scripts/lint/ts-ratchet.mjs + ts-debt.json: every eslint-disable (per rule it names), every @ts- directive and every directive with no `-- why` in app/ and packages/ is now held to a declared, explained ceiling, blocking in ci.yml's node-quality job and in .githooks/pre-push, with autofix.yml lowering the numbers via `--tighten` on every PR.

Needs a test run: a mutation score means mutating app/_lib/db/ and re-running the suite per mutant, and this session has no shell execution and no node_modules (no network to `npm ci`), so no baseline could be produced and no honest gate threshold chosen; committing an unrun harness into a repo whose rule is that a gate must operate would be the wrong trade.

lessons: This repository already answers most maturity findings in-tree, and the answers are scripts, not prose: scripts/security/check-actions.mjs (run-injection, unpinned actions), .github/rulesets/main.json + scripts/review/gate-check.mjs (required checks), scripts/lint/ruff-ratchet.mjs (debt ceilings), scripts/review/constitution-check.mjs (forbidden change classes). Read scripts/ and .github/ before believing a scan's 'missing' list — three of four items dispatched here were already closed.

The house pattern for a guardrail here is: a declared ceiling in a committed file, a blocking check in CI, a `--tighten` that lowers it unattended in autofix.yml, dependency-free node:* so it runs in jobs without `npm ci`, and an explicit refusal to read 'I found nothing' as 'there is nothing'. Copy that shape rather than inventing one; ruff-ratchet.mjs is the reference implementation.

An Ascent lane with no shell cannot produce any measured baseline (mutation score, coverage, lockfile, resolved SHA). When a baseline IS derivable by reading files, derive it with a machine (ripgrep counts) using the exact regex the new check will use — a hand-tallied number was off by one on the first attempt, and a wrong ceiling turns a new gate into a red build for everyone.
